description: Plan or start a background Docker pull for a local-ydb image on the selected target. Without confirm=true it returns inspect and pull commands only; with confirm=true it returns a jobId for local_ydb_pull_status unless the image is already present.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

confirm.description: Must be true to start the background Docker pull. Omit or false for plan-only output.

image.description: Container image to pull. Defaults to the selected profile image.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

name: local_ydb_pull_image
